overview: The paper proposes EigenScore, an unsupervised out-of-distribution (OOD) detection method for diffusion models that leverages the inflation of the leading eigenvalues of the posterior covariance (derived from the denoiser's Jacobian) as a signal for distribution shift, validated across multiple image benchmarks and ablation studies.

modules.name: Dataset Preprocessing and Loading
modules.description: Handles loading, resizing to 32x32, and splitting standard image datasets (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, CelebA, TinyImageNet) into in-distribution and out-of-distribution sets for training, validation, and testing.

modules.name: Diffusion Model Training (EDM Backbone)
modules.description: Implements the training pipeline for the diffusion models using the EDM framework (Karras et al.), including the forward corruption process and the denoiser network optimization, to obtain the InD denoisers required for feature extraction.

modules.name: Jacobian-Free Subspace Iteration
modules.description: Implements Algorithm 2 to efficiently estimate the top-K eigenvalues of the posterior covariance matrix using finite differences of the denoiser output and QR orthogonalization, bypassing explicit Jacobian computation.

modules.name: EigenScore Feature Extraction and Aggregation
modules.description: Computes the EigenScore feature vector M(x) across selected timesteps and multiple noise realizations, summing the top-K eigenvalues for each step and aggregating the results as defined in Equations 9 and 10.

modules.name: Statistical Normalization and OOD Scoring
modules.description: Implements Algorithm 1 to compute Z-score statistics using the InD training set and applies this normalization to the EigenScore features of test samples, yielding the final scalar OOD detection score.

modules.name: Baseline OOD Methods Integration
modules.description: Provides implementations or wrappers for baseline methods (NLL, DDPM-OOD, LMD, DiffPath, etc.) to enable direct comparison against EigenScore using the same trained diffusion models and evaluation datasets.

modules.name: Evaluation and Metrics Calculation
modules.description: Calculates the primary evaluation metric (AUROC) for all InD-OOD dataset pairs and compares the performance of EigenScore against baselines, aggregating results for reporting.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Manages and executes ablation experiments to evaluate the impact of key hyperparameters, including the number of timesteps (T), number of noise repetitions (I), number of eigenvalues (K), and the finite difference step size (c).

modules.name: Visualization and Spectral Analysis
modules.description: Generates paper-specific visualizations, including violin plots of eigenvalue distributions, uncertainty maps, histograms comparing InD/OOD score separability, and AUROC curves as a function of diffusion timesteps.
